title: What The Voice Knows (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 100bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal music philosophy absurdist family Wilma
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The voice is the one instrument that everyone is born with
Whether they use it well is a different conversation worth
Having — but the potential is distributed equally
The voice doesn't require a budget or a teacher or a fee

[Pre-Chorus]
My own voice is a baritone with a tendency to drop
At the end of sentences — which I've been told to stop

[Chorus]
What does the voice know that I don't know?
It knows the signature of the person before the words flow
What does the voice know before it says a thing?
It knows the territory of the room before it's had its sing
That's my boy

[Verse 2]
Wilma's voice is something I could pick from a hundred voices
In any room in any context — these are the choices
The voice makes for itself — a texture and a temperature
That is entirely its own and is not amateur

[Bridge]
The voice remembers things the mind has long since filed
I heard my father's voice when Joel spoke as a child
And for a moment everything was in the room at once
The voice holds the genealogy without the fronts

[Outro]
Voice knows… the person is in the sound… voice knows
That's my boy
